a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly leaves us both empty when the first storm hits. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If the episode continues, I'll operate the generator with you every round after that so you can build up your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. I'm sorry this breaks our deal. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take any more.
